skills.name: SQLMap evidence handling: Locate SQLMap output
skills.description: Find the app-managed artifact folder for an authorized run.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Keep engine files private and SQLMap run artifacts in workspace `.sqlmap/output`.
2. Associate each artifact with one authorized engagement and follow the agreed retention period.
3. Use workspace `.sqlmap/output`; do not confuse it with the private engine under `filesDir/runtimes/sqlmap`.
4. Review files before sharing; remove credentials, personal data, and unnecessary response content.

Safety: share only minimum redacted evidence. Do not include dumped records, live credentials, server files, or data outside the approved scope.
